label: copy-phase input w (early-middle of copy, esp. before b)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the fed-back input is w (99.5% of activations, 99.8% of mass). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. It is very sparse even inside that context: only about 1.1% of copy-phase w inputs activate. Activity peaks at recall_idx 3-4 (w was original token 2-3), in long sequences (L 7-9) with 3 or more outputs still to go, and most strongly when the token being output next is b (60% of mass). q, 0 and w as the output are weaker. The top activations are almost all of the form ..w b.. at original position 2. The recorded conjunction has high precision (about 0.63) but captures only about 39% of mass. The broad predicate (copy phase and input w) has recall near 1 but precision about 0.01. The remaining conditions that decide which w-inputs fire were not found.
